▶ 20261020 K스탁 라이브
▶ 월~금 13:00 

📌 출연
진행 : 온인주 앵커
제작 : 양경식 PD, 권수지 작가, 김유환 AD

📌 솔리다임 상장, SK하이닉스 주주가치 논란
• SK하이닉스가 인수한 솔리다임의 미국 증시 별도 상장을 추진하면서 중복상장 논란 확대
• 금융당국은 기존 상장사 주주가치 훼손 가능성을 지적
• SK·SK스퀘어·SK하이닉스에 이어 솔리다임까지 상장하면 한 지배구조 안에 4개 상장사
• 다음 주 SK하이닉스 실적 발표에서 솔리다임 상장에 대한 회사 입장과 주주가치 보호 방안이 주요 쟁점이 될 전망

💾 CXMT, 매출 급증에도 주가 급락
• CXMT의 올해 1~9월 매출이 전년 대비 8배 이상 증가할 것으로 전망
• 하지만 3분기 순이익 증가율은 1~4% 수준에 그칠 것으로 예상
• 매출 성장에 비해 이익 증가세가 둔화되면서 주가가 장중 9% 가까이 급락
• CXMT의 성장 둔화가 메모리 업황 정점론으로까지 해석되며 시장의 경계심 확대
• 다만 중국 정부의 정책 개입이 큰 만큼 CXMT 실적만으로 메모리 업황 전체를 판단하기는 어려움

📉 코스피 급락, 수급이 핵심
• JP모건은 최근 급락의 배경으로 자사주 매입 둔화·AI 투자 우려·201일 이동평균선 이탈을 지목
• 코스피 밸류에이션은 충분히 낮아졌지만 아직 바닥을 확인할 수 있는 수급이 부족하다고 평가
• 중장기 한국 증시 강세 전망은 유지하지만 수급 불균형과 위험회피 심리 해소에는 시간이 필요

💰 외국인 수급·신용융자 부담
• 삼성전자 자사주 매입 종료에 이어 SK하이닉스 자사주 매입도 마무리 단계
• 외국인은 지난주 약 11조2천억 원 순매도, 9주 연속 순매도
• 최근 하루 순매수가 나오기도 했지만 다시 대규모 매도로 전환
• 신용융자 잔고도 약 32조 원 수준으로 여전히 부담
• 외국인 매수의 지속 여부와 신용융자 감소가 시장 안정의 핵심 변수

🤖 빅테크 실적, AI 수익성 확인
• 메타·테슬라·램리서치 실적 발표에 주목
• 시장의 관심은 이제 AI에 얼마나 투자하느냐보다 실제 얼마나 돈을 버느냐로 이동
• 메타는 AI 광고 사업의 성과와 현금창출력 개선 여부가 핵심
• 램리서치는 반도체 장비 수요를 보여주는 동시에 향후 메모리 공급과잉 우려를 키울 가능성도 체크

🎯 핵심 투자 포인트
• 솔리다임 상장 → SK하이닉스 주주가치 논란
• CXMT → 매출 성장보다 이익 증가세 둔화에 주목
• 코스피 → 외국인 수급과 신용융자 부담이 바닥 확인의 핵심
• 빅테크 실적 → AI 투자 → 실제 수익 창출 여부 확인

snippet.title: You Kicked My Brother, So Now You’ll Pay! 😂👊
snippet.description:
The Little Girl Who Planted Stars

Every evening, a little girl named Ruby walked into her grandmother's garden carrying a small silver bucket. She knelt beside the flowerbeds, dug tiny holes in the soil, and carefully placed something inside.

Her neighbors assumed she was planting seeds.

One afternoon, a boy named Henry asked what she was growing.

“Stars,” Ruby replied.

Henry laughed. “Stars grow in the sky, not in gardens.”

Ruby shook her head. “Grandma says that everything beautiful needs somewhere to begin.”

Henry thought she was pretending, but he became curious enough to watch her work.

Ruby explained that her grandmother had once shown her how to grow flowers from tiny seeds. Each seed looked ordinary, but with enough care, it could become something wonderful.

Ruby had decided that stars must work the same way.

She collected small pieces of silver paper, shaped them into stars, and buried them beneath the flowers. She watered the soil every evening, believing that one day the garden would shine.

Her grandmother never laughed at the idea. Instead, she helped Ruby dig, plant flowers, and decorate the garden with small lights.

When winter arrived, the flowers disappeared beneath the cold soil. Ruby worried that her stars had failed to grow.

Her grandmother sat beside her and explained that some things needed time that could not be hurried.

“Growth isn't always visible,” she said. “Sometimes, the most important work happens where nobody can see it.”

Ruby waited.

During the following months, she continued caring for the garden. She learned how to remove weeds, protect young plants, and recognize when the soil needed water.

When spring arrived, colorful flowers began appearing across the garden.

Ruby was delighted.

The silver stars had not grown into plants, but the garden looked more beautiful than she had imagined. She invited Henry to see it, and he admitted that he had been wrong to laugh at her idea.

Together, they created a small nighttime garden using paper stars, tiny lamps, and reflective decorations. The flowers glowed beneath the lights, making the garden look like a little piece of the night sky.

Their project attracted other children from the neighborhood.

Soon, everyone wanted to help. Some planted flowers, others painted stones, and a few children built a wooden sign for the entrance.

Ruby's grandmother watched them from the kitchen window.

She had been feeling lonely since her husband passed away, and the garden had become her favorite place to remember him. Seeing the children working together brought laughter back into the house.

One evening, Ruby noticed her grandmother sitting quietly beside the flowerbeds.

“Are you sad?” Ruby asked.

“A little,” her grandmother admitted. “I miss someone who used to help me plant these flowers.”

Ruby took her hand.

“Maybe we can plant something for him.”

They chose a small rosebush and placed it near the center of the garden. Ruby buried one of her silver paper stars beneath it.

She did not believe the star would grow into a real star anymore. Instead, she understood that it could represent a memory, a hope, or a person she wanted to remember.

Years later, Ruby became a landscape designer. She created gardens for schools, hospitals, and public spaces, always including small areas where people could plant something meaningful.

Her first project was the garden where she had buried her silver stars.

The flowers had grown tall, the rosebush had spread across the fence, and the little lamps still glowed every evening.

Henry, who had become an elementary school teacher, brought his students to visit.

Ruby told them that when she was young, she had believed stars could grow from the ground.

The children laughed, but she smiled.

“Perhaps they can,” she said. “Not the stars you see in the sky, but the things that make your world brighter.”

She handed each child a small paper star and invited them to plant a flower.

By sunset, the garden was filled with tiny hands, fresh soil, and excited conversations.

Ruby watched the children working together and remembered her grandmother's words.

Everything beautiful needed somewhere to begin.

And sometimes, all it took was one small idea, a little patience, and someone willing to believe in it long enough for it to grow.

snippet.title: Alina Makes Chicken Soup for  Phophoo ❤️ | Village Family Storychicken soup #villagelife
snippet.description:
When Phophoo falls sick with a fever and body pain, Ali and Alina lovingly take care of her. ❤️ Ali brings fresh chicken, and Alina prepares a warm, homemade chicken soup in a traditional village courtyard. When Phophoo tastes the soup, she praises Alina’s cooking and gives Ali and Alina a heartfelt dua for a happy, blessed life together.

Watch this heartwarming village family story filled with love, care, delicious homemade food, and Phophoo’s beautiful blessing. 🥣💕

### 🍲 Homemade Chicken Soup Recipe

**Ingredients:**
- 1 kg chicken
- 1 carrot, finely chopped
- 1 cup cabbage, thinly sliced
- 1 small green capsicum, chopped
- 1 small onion, chopped
- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
- 2–3 garlic cloves and a small piece of ginger for the stock
- Salt to taste
- Black pepper to taste
- 1–2 tsp vinegar
- 1–2 tsp soy sauce
- 1–2 tbsp cornflour
- Water for mixing cornflour
- 1 egg, beaten
- Water as needed for chicken stock
- A little oil

**Cooking Method:**
1. Boil the chicken with garlic, ginger, salt, and water until tender. Strain and reserve the chicken stock.
2. Separate the cooked chicken from the bones and shred it.
3. Heat a little oil in a handi. Fry the chopped onion and ginger-garlic paste.
4. Add carrot, cabbage, capsicum, and shredded chicken. Season with salt, black pepper, vinegar, and soy sauce.
5. Pour in the reserved chicken stock and let the soup simmer.
6. Mix cornflour with a little cold water until smooth. Slowly add it to the soup while stirring.
7. Beat the egg and pour it into the simmering soup in a thin stream while stirring gently.
8. Cook for a few more minutes until the soup thickens and is piping hot. Serve warm.

El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, ha culpado a la inmigración de los disturbios registrados en Francia y ha lanzado una advertencia a los países europeos: "Si Europa no cierra sus fronteras y expulsa a los delincuentes, como los que protestan, Europa está acabada".

En unas declaraciones a los periodistas antes de viajar a Kansas para participar en un acto de campaña, Trump calificó la situación francesa de "muy triste" e insistió en que el origen de los problemas no está en las escuelas, sino en la inmigración.

"Lo que está pasando en Francia tiene que ver con la inmigración. No con las escuelas, ni con nada. Es inmigración", afirmó el mandatario, que aseguró haber trasladado este mensaje al presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron, durante su primer mandato.

"Cierre sus fronteras", recordó Trump que le dijo al dirigente francés, al que advirtió de que permitir la entrada de personas que, según sus palabras, no aman el país, sus edificios ni su arte terminaría provocando graves consecuencias.

Sus declaraciones llegan tras varios días de disturbios en Francia, con daños en edificios públicos y comercios, detenciones y medidas de seguridad adoptadas por las autoridades. Macron, por su parte, atribuyó los episodios violentos a grupos radicales y delincuentes.

Trump vuelve así a situar el control migratorio en el centro de su discurso político, mientras sus palabras reabren el debate sobre la inmigración, la seguridad y la respuesta europea ante los disturbios.

En el vídeo, el presidente estadounidense expone su postura y reclama medidas más duras en las fronteras europeas.

snippet.title: Underwater Tunnels Aren't Dug. They're Sunk. 🌊
snippet.description:
Drilling under soft seabed mud is slow and risky, so many underwater tunnels are built on land instead — as giant concrete pieces that float, sink and join themselves underwater.
Each standard element of Europe's Fehmarnbelt tunnel is 712 ft long (almost two football fields) and weighs about 73,500 metric tons, more than the Titanic. Capped at both ends, it floats; with ballast, it's lowered into a trench dug in the seabed. Hydraulic jacks pull it until a soft rubber gasket touches the last piece. Then the water trapped between the two end walls is pumped out: now there's air on one side and the whole sea on the other. Down deep, that pressure pushes the element with over 10,000 tons and squeezes the gasket shut — the water that should flood the tunnel is what seals it.

3D animation: a simplified illustration of a modern immersed-tube tunnel element (no real brand); motions are sped up for clarity (a real immersion takes hours).

Sources:
• Femern A/S / Tunneling Online (May–June 2026): Fehmarnbelt standard element 217 m × 42 m × 9 m, 73,500 t with 4,500 t of ballast concrete, 89 elements, trench up to 40–45 m deep, connected with hydraulic arms.
• Trelleborg — Gina gasket: primary seal compressed by the outside water pressure once the water between the bulkheads is pumped out; Omega seal inside (also supplied for Fehmarnbelt).
• ITA-AITES — IJ tunnel (Amsterdam): releasing the water pressure in the joint space compresses the gasket.
• Wikipedia — Transbay Tube (San Francisco Bay, 1969): 57 immersed sections, 3.6 miles, up to 135 ft deep.
• Wikipedia — RMS Titanic: displacement 52,310 tons.
Force estimate: pressure at ~35 m depth (≈ 51 psi) × the 42 m × 9 m end face ≈ 13,600 t (15,000 short tons).

snippet.description:
Після звільнення з посади Головнокомандувача ЗСУ в липні 2026 року Олександр Сирський залишився у військовій сфері. Він пройшов військово-лікарську комісію, був визнаний придатним до служби та вступив до докторантури Національного університету оборони України, що знаходиться в Києві. Відтак, зараз він працює над своєю дисертацією.

Від цивільних і політичних посад Сирський свідомо відмовився, адже заявив, що планує присвятити себе тому, чим займався все життя – ділитися багаторічним бойовим досвідом та навчати українських й іноземних військових. Також нещодавно Сирський уперше з'явився на публіці в цивільному одязі та дав велике інтерв'ю BBC. За його словами, здатність росії наступати – зламана. А ця війна, як і всі інші, закінчиться переговорами, умови яких залежать від успіхів України на полі бою.

Após acusar o presidente Lula de "mau-caráter e mentiroso" e ameaçar fazer delação premiada envolvendo Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), Luchsinger decidiu retirar suas filhas do Brasil de forma apressada. A decisão foi motivada pelo aumento de ameaças e por um misterioso acidente de carro sofrido por sua filha mais velha em São Bernardo do Campo.

Enquanto novas mensagens de WhatsApp comprovam reuniões e churrascos com ministros de Estado na mansão de R$ 46 mil mensais alugada por ela e Lulinha em Brasília, a oposição já colheu dezenas de assinaturas para a instalação de uma CPMI e pediu sua inclusão no Programa de Proteção a Testemunhas. No episódio de hoje do podcast 15 Minutos, Rossana Bitencourt e Frederico Juncker analisam o desespero nos bastidores do Planalto, a frágil defesa do advogado de Lulinha e a reviravolta do PGR Paulo Gonet no STF.

DESTAQUES:
[00:00] Relatos sobre deslocamentos de familiares e preocupações com segurança pessoal
[01:50] Menções a encontros e frequentadores de reuniões no ambiente privado em Brasília
[03:45] Articulações da oposição para pedidos de comissões parlamentares e mecanismos de proteção
[06:10] Manifestações da defesa jurídica sobre residência no exterior e consultorias
[09:25] Parecer da Procuradoria-Geral da República sobre pedidos de apuração contra ministros
[12:10] Encaminhamentos sobre imputações do Código Penal e considerações finais
